change_policy.summary: README identity is protected. Do not wholesale-replace README.md with theory manifestos, product pitches, or unrelated projects.
allowed_changes: Small factual fixes (links, version, install commands)
Adding a new section that preserves required H1 and anchors
Updating the collapsible ToE example while keeping it marked non-authoritative
Syncing README.sv.md with the same identity rules
required_for_identity_edits: Update config/readme_identity.json if anchors intentionally change
Note the change in PR template checkbox for protected docs
Prefer CODEOWNERS review on README.md and config/readme_identity.json
disallowed: Replacing H1 with a ToE or third-party project title
Promoting SYM/HYP sketches to sound like EST in the README body
Deleting Boundary rules or Quick start without a reviewed identity-file update
